_comment: One source of truth for week 11's rubric. The grader scores from this file, the homework's grading table is copied from it, and the Canvas rubric is generated from it. `suite` says which test run scores an item — 'checks' is `dotnet test Project.Checks` (canonical, replaced wholesale by the grader), 'tests' is `dotnet test Project.Tests` (the student's OWN suite, run as-is and never replaced). The dictated student fact carries the WEEK — Week11_ARemovedRecordStaysGone — and it is the lab's Task 3 fact on the student's own registry. Check 1 is the came-forward check, green before the student starts, and it now holds all of week 10 as well. Check 2 is the homework's Task 2. Homework Task 1 (see a removed record come back) changes no code and turns nothing green. The run-it item stays a BUILD-it item (W10.4): running needs the student's connection string, which is correctly not in the repo. The graded repo is the PROJECT repo (D1b).

Check1_WeeksFourToTenStillHold.label: Weeks 4-10 still hold — everything check 1 covered last week, plus last week's four: a record shaped for a table, a migration, Save and Load round-tripping, and a second save changing the row

Check2_ARemovedRecordStaysGone.label: A record removed on the next run is gone from the table, and the records that weren't removed keep their rows

Week11_ARemovedRecordStaysGone.label: Your test: a record loaded, removed and saved is gone the next time the registry loads — written by you, before the fix, green in your own suite

repoReachable.label: Public project repo exists at the URL you submitted, and clones

programBuilds.label: The project compiles from a clean clone — it cannot be RUN anywhere but your own machine, because your connection string is not in the repo

gitignoreClean.label: bin/ and obj/ tracked nowhere in the project repo — the .gitignore holding

commits.label: 3+ commits on THIS week's branch 👀 (meaningful messages are a judgment call)
